owner: Local Compose OpenTofu; Harbor API resources only
state: Independent GitLab HTTP backend, enforced client encryption and native locking; no ARC, Kubernetes or Harbor state storage
credentials: Local vault reader supplies emergency API and ephemeral robot inputs. Provisioning identity never enters provider subprocesses, hosts or Kubernetes.
visibility: Both projects require authentication; public/private describe repository credential scopes, not anonymous access
quota: Whole GiB only. Pinned native patch reads exactly one project quota during refresh/import and propagates update failures. Fractional limits require explicit field review.

retained_fields.system_oidc_configuration: Argo installation environment and retained Keycloak client owner
retained_fields.system_gc_schedule: Manual only; read-only verification rejects an automatic schedule. No GC writer before deployed/rollback/signature preservation proof.
retained_fields.project_proxy_metadata: Not adopted; no proxy project or upstream registry
retained_fields.project_cve_allowlist: Not adopted; must remain empty. Existing entries stop a plan before any API write.
retained_fields.project_deployment_security: Not adopted; no registered Harbor scanner. Existing severity gates stop a plan before any API write.
retained_fields.scanner_registration: Not adopted; CI scans before publication, no bundled Harbor scanner
retained_fields.robot_secret_version: Vault input version 1 remains fixed; routine project/retention apply cannot rotate credentials

retention: Keep all tagged and untagged artifacts and accessories; no schedule. Reject new pushes at quota. Immutable release/deploy/rollback tags protect artifacts; automatic deletion requires separate digest-preservation checks.
destruction: prevent_destroy on every resource; no force_destroy, no blind retry after interrupted creation
